Author: Valenth Siveria
Name: BlackJack Buttler
Punchline: Good evening. I am the Buttler, turning even the wildest Blackjack tables into a perfectly orchestrated game of cards.
Description:
You tend to your guests; I shall tend to the table. From cards and wagers to payouts and records, every detail is in capable hands. The rules remain yours, of course.

And should chaos arise, fear not. Even the most troublesome guests can be managed with a little patience and impeccable manners.

BlackJack Buttler will take care of:

Game Management: Dealing cards, tracking turns, and enforcing Blackjack rules.
Player Management: Managing players, hands, splits, and special actions.
Banking & Payouts: Handling wagers, Gil balances, trades, and payouts.
Customization: Flexible rules, chat messages, and automation settings.
Statistics & History: Keeping track of sessions, rounds, and game history.
Visuals: Optional in-world card displays and table visualizations.

/bjb - opens the blackjack buttler tool
